baseline_models.mechanism: A hostile collective is passively driven toward a fixed destination while organized restraint holds its front for its rear, producing a synchronized convoy rather than an undifferentiated rush.

activation_trace.role: Gathering a group while driving it to a destination supplies the convoy's centripetal movement.
Enmity supplies the relational identity of the gathered collective.
Kindled fire supplies the stated terminal destination.
Organized restraint, including holding a column's front for its rear, supplies rank synchronization.

changed_reading.before: A hostile crowd is gathered and restrained on the way to fire.
changed_reading.after: The hostile collective is driven as a regulated convoy whose ranks are held together until the whole body reaches its destination.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing passive can combine restraint with apportionment: the mass produced by the muster is converted into controlled groups.

activation_trace.role: Collective gathering supplies the mass on which grouping operates.
Division and distribution supply the operation that apportions the gathered mass.
Groups of people supply the resulting cohort structure.

changed_reading.after: Their collective is both controlled and apportioned into cohorts, so the final verb describes formation as well as restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier differentiation, measured provision, and itemized assignment make the focus cohorting part of a surah-wide grammar of precise apportionment rather than ad hoc crowd control.

activation_trace.role: Distribution anchors the changed reading in the focus verb.
Detail that exposes parts and meanings supplies a differentiating template.
Deliberate determination by measure supplies administrative calibration.
Comprehensive totality makes the assignment exhaustive rather than partial.
Repeated measured determination reinforces regulated placement.

structural_cues: 41:3 differentiates discourse, 41:10 measures provisions, and 41:12 gives each heaven its affair before 41:19 presents an ordered passive procession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated differentiation, measure, and itemized assignment; I infer that the focus distribution belongs to the same administrative grammar. The live alternative is thematic recurrence of order without a procedural link.

changed_reading.before: The cohorts are a practical way to control a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The cohorts are exhaustively differentiated and measured units in a larger order of exact assignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to come willingly or unwillingly activates the two passives in the focus as loss of autonomous movement: the enemies are made to enter the same ordered compliance that creation accepted.

activation_trace.role: Driven gathering anchors compelled motion toward the destination.
Organized restraint supplies external control over the moving collective.
Obedient compliance supplies the positive pole of commanded movement.
Compelling another into what is hated supplies the negative pole realized by the focus passives.

structural_cues: 41:11 pairs willing and unwilling arrival; 41:19 suppresses the agents of both gathering and restraint and marks only the destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commanded arrival under either consent or compulsion and two agentless focus passives; I infer a shared movement-control pattern. The alternative is that 41:11 concerns cosmic obedience while 41:19 is only a local forced march.

changed_reading.before: The enemies happen to be rounded up under guard.
changed_reading.after: Their procession enacts compulsory compliance: resistance no longer grants control over pace, rank, or destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refused and burdened hearing before the focus reverses immediately after it into embodied testimony. Organized holding therefore reads as procedural staging: the collective is queued until each case can be exposed by its own sensory witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Holding the front for the rear supplies the queueing operation.
Understanding and compliance, here negated, supply the earlier failed reception.
Heaviness in the ear materializes the earlier refusal to receive.
Presence with direct observation supplies testimony at the convoy's arrival.
The bodily skin supplies an internal witness carried by every queued person.
Intentional deeds supply the evidentiary object of the testimony.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from 41:4-5's refused and heavy hearing through 41:19's holding to 41:20's testimony by hearing, sight, and skins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the refusal-to-testimony reversal and immediate adjacency; I infer that rank control also stages cases for witness. The alternative is military restraint followed by a separate evidentiary scene only after arrival.

changed_reading.before: Restraint is only logistical control of a dangerous mass.
changed_reading.after: Restraint is also an evidentiary queue, synchronizing arrival so each embodied record can testify to its deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destination becomes more than a terminus: nearby context names fire a settled dwelling and then directly restates it as the recompense and lasting abode of God's enemies. The convoy is delivery into an executed sentence.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire anchors the destination whose function is revised.
Driven gathering supplies delivery into that destination.
Residence and settled stay convert a waypoint into habitation.
A deed answered by its recompense supplies the judicial relation between conduct and destination.
Persistence not quickly overtaken by decay supplies terminal duration.

structural_cues: 41:28 repeats the focus cluster 'enemies of God' and 'the fire' while explicitly naming recompense and an abiding home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct lexical recurrence plus dwelling, recompense, and permanence; I infer that transport performs sentence execution. The alternative is that 41:24 and 41:28 elaborate punishment without making the focus procession juridical.

changed_reading.before: Fire is merely where the controlled procession is headed.
changed_reading.after: Arrival transfers the procession into proportionate recompense and settled permanence; the destination executes the sentence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companions joined to companions, prior communities, and named misleaders make the focus groups relationally structured. The gathered are plausibly cohorting by networks of influence and shared history rather than being divided into arbitrary batches.

activation_trace.role: Groups of people anchor cohort formation in the focus verb.
A companion joined to a companion supplies the social bond inside a cohort.
A community or type supplies transhistorical collective structure.
Leading away from guidance supplies the influence relation later contested within the gathered body.

structural_cues: 41:25 links assigned companions with past communities; 41:29 has the condemned identify two agents of their misguidance and demand a reversed hierarchy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired associates, communities, and blamed misleaders; I infer that the focus grouping preserves culpable relations. The live alternative is temporal or logistical batching with no social-network principle.

changed_reading.before: The enemies are divided into interchangeable crowd-control units.
changed_reading.after: They are assembled in socially coupled cohorts that expose companionship, influence, and shared historical alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later transformation of an enemy into an intimate ally makes 'enemies of God' a relational and enacted alignment rather than an immutable human substance. At the focus event, that relation has reached its adjudicated form.

activation_trace.role: Enmity anchors the classification being revised.
The same enmity branch supplies a relation shown capable of changing.
Repelling harm by moving it aside supplies the action that interrupts hostility.
Love, support, and alliance supply the relation into which enmity can reverse.

structural_cues: 41:34 explicitly places عَدَاوَة and وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ on opposite sides of a behavioral transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies a hostility-to-alliance simile; I infer that the focus label names a settled relation at that Day, not an ontology. The alternative is ethical hyperbole restricted to interpersonal hostility.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names a fixed kind of people.
changed_reading.after: The phrase names people whose enacted relation of hostility has persisted to judgment, even though enmity as a relation was in principle reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between being cast into fire and coming secure on the Day activates the distribution branch of the focus verb as destination sorting. The focus convoy is one routed side of an adjudicated bifurcation.

activation_trace.role: Distribution anchors the sorting operation in the focus.
Fire anchors one terminal route.
Casting something until it lies there supplies forced placement on the fire route.
Coming and arriving supply the contrasting route's voluntary-looking terminal motion.
Settled security supplies the contrasting arrival state.

structural_cues: 41:40 explicitly contrasts one cast into fire with one who comes secure on the Day of rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a two-term eschatological contrast; I infer a routing schema that sharpens focus distribution. The alternative is a moral comparison with no claim about a shared sorting operation.

changed_reading.before: The focus follows only one crowd toward one destination.
changed_reading.after: That crowd is the fire-bound output of a broader sorting operation contrasted with secure arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of any lateral escape and the surah's final encompassing closure turn ordered restraint into total containment: no member can peel away spatially, and no deed can exit the field of knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Organized holding anchors the containment mechanism in the focus.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape vector that context denies.
Physical surrounding supplies an enclosing boundary around every possible deviation.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and seizure extends containment from bodies to records.

structural_cues: 41:48 says they have no مَحِيص, and 41:54 closes by saying that God encompasses every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied deviation and comprehensive encompassing; I infer that the focus rank-control realizes both spatial and epistemic enclosure. The alternative is that final encompassing is exclusively knowledge, not a spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: Guards keep a procession orderly while it moves.
changed_reading.after: The procession is sealed against lateral escape and evidentiary disappearance; restraint is one local expression of total enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping beneath أَعْدَاءُ; it remains anchored through that supplied split mapping, focus distribution, and the surah's measure/register cues. Render only as a secondary administrative resonance, never as a replacement translation or etymological claim for 'enemies.'

activation_trace.role: Counting and collecting numbers turn the hostile plural into an exploratory enumerable docket.
Distribution supplies the operation applied to what has been counted.
Entering a name into a register gives the count a docket-like social form.
A measure that brings each thing to its limit supplies exact enumeration.
Comprehensive totality blocks the image of an incomplete count.

changed_reading.before: The plural denotes only a hostile mass.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, the mass resonates as an exhaustive register: every member counted, entered, and apportioned before delivery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the illumination branch of the packet's ن و ر normalization beneath the surface نَّار; it remains anchored because the fire destination is immediately followed by embodied witness and later paired with removal of concealment. Render as a qualified disclosure function of the scene, not as a denial that the word means fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ between controlled muster and the testimony of 41:20

activation_trace.role: Light and illumination make the fire destination an exploratory exposure field.
Witness by direct presence supplies what becomes manifest at arrival.
Removal of concealment supplies the disclosure operation adjacent to being cast into fire.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only a punitive destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fire is also the scene's illumination chamber, where hidden embodied records become manifest and testify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the agricultural B008 branch of ح ش ر into an eschatological procession; it remains anchored in the focus verb and gains a mechanism from rescue immediately before the muster plus later earth-and-fruit imagery. Render only as a harvest-sorting analogy, not as the lexical sense demanded by the syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُحْشَرُ immediately after the rescue in 41:18

activation_trace.role: Crop residue remaining after harvest supplies the image of a remainder collected after separation.
Rescue by separating out supplies the first pass of an exploratory harvest-sorting sequence.
Earth and vegetation stirring to life keep the agricultural material domain active.
Ripened fruit supplies the later yield image that completes the harvest analogy.

changed_reading.before: Rescue and enemy-muster are unrelated adjacent outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rescue removes one yield and the following muster gathers the exposed remainder, like a second pass over a harvested field.

strongest_changes: يُوزَعُونَ shifted from generic restraint to measured cohort control, compulsory compliance, and an evidentiary queue.
41:24 and 41:28 changed fire from a waypoint into proportionate recompense and settled permanence.
41:25-29 gave the cohorts social structure, while 41:40 sharpened their movement into one output of destination sorting.
41:34 made enmity relational and potentially reversible; 41:48 and 41:54 then closed the adjudicated procession against escape or concealment.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined early refusal and cosmic compliance to the focus passives, immediate bodily testimony, a later exact enemy-fire recurrence, social grouping, binary routing, and final enclosure. Split mappings also exposed counted-docket, illumination, and post-harvest readings that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The distribution and grouping branches of و ز ع may coexist with organized restraint, but the focus syntax most securely supports restraint.
The hostility-to-alliance transformation in 41:34 may illuminate only interpersonal ethics rather than the scope of 'enemies of God.'
The counted-docket, illumination, and harvest models are packet-anchored analogies, not replacement lexical glosses.
